{{Infobox football league season | competition = [[Chinese Jia-A League]] | season = 2001 | winners = [[Dalian Shide F.C.|Dalian Shide]] (6th title) | relegated = None | continentalcup1 = [[2002–03 AFC Champions League|AFC Champions League]] | continentalcup1 qualifiers = {{ubl|[[Dalian Shide F.C.|Dalian Shide]] | [[Shanghai Shenhua F.C.|Shanghai Shenhua]]}} | league topscorer = [[Hao Haidong]] (16 goals) | matches = 182 | total goals = 474 | average attendance = 18,296 | prevseason = [[2000 Chinese Jia-A League|2000]] | nextseason = [[2002 Chinese Jia-A League|2002]] }} The '''2001 [[Chinese Jia-A League]] season''' was the eighth season of professional association football and the 40th top-tier overall league season in China. The league started on March 11 and ended on December 16, with [[Dalian Shide F.C.|Dalian Shide]] retaining the championship. ==Promotion and relegation== '''Teams promoted from 2000 Jia-B League''' *[[Harbin Guoli F.C.|Shaanxi Guoli]] *[[Bayi Football Team|August 1st]] '''Teams relegated after end of [[2000 Chinese Jia-A League|2000 Jia-A League]]''' *[[Xiamen Blue Lions F.C.|Xiamen Xiaxin]] *[[Yanbian Funde F.C.|Jilin Aodong]] ==Overview== The season would see [[Dalian Shide F.C.|Dalian Shide]] continue their dominance within the league and saw them win their sixth league title. On the other end of the table [[Guangzhou City F.C.|Shenyang Ginde]] would gain the fewest points in Chinese league history, although because it was an expansion season they avoided relegation. Also the [[AFC Champions League Elite|Asian Club Championship]] was rebranded as the [[AFC Champions League Elite|AFC Champions League]] and would now allow two Chinese teams to enter the competition. ==Personnel== {| class="wikitable sortable" style="font-size:95%" |- !Team !Manager |- | [[Bayi Football Team|August 1st]] | |- | [[Beijing Guoan F.C.|Beijing Guoan]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Wei Kexing]] |- | [[Chongqing Liangjiang Athletic F.C.|Chongqing Lifan]] | {{flagicon|KOR}} [[Lee Jang-soo]] |- | [[Dalian Shide F.C.|Dalian Shide]] | {{flagicon|FRY}} [[Milorad Kosanović]] |- | [[Liaoning F.C.|Liaoning Fushun]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Wang Hongli (footballer)|Wang Hongli]] |- | [[Qingdao Hainiu F.C.|Qingdao Beer]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Guo Zuojin]] |- | [[Harbin Guoli F.C.|Shaanxi Guoli]] | |- | [[Shandong Taishan F.C.|Shandong Luneng]] | {{flagicon|RUS}} [[Boris Ignatyev]] |- | [[Shanghai Shenhua F.C.|Shanghai Shenhua]] | {{flagicon|FRY}} [[Ilija Petković]] |- | [[Guangzhou City F.C.|Shenyang Ginde]] | {{flagicon|FRA}} [[Alain Laurier]] |- | [[Shenzhen F.C.|Shenzhen Kejian Ping'an]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Zhu Guanghu]] |- | [[Sichuan First City F.C.|Sichuan Shangwutong]] | {{flagicon|ENG}} [[Bob Houghton]] |- | [[Tianjin Jinmen Tiger F.C.|Tianjin TEDA]] | {{flagicon|URU}} [[Nelson Agresta]] |- | [[Yunnan Hongta F.C.|Yunnan Hongta]] | {{flagicon|CHN}} [[Qi Wusheng]] |} == Foreign players == As a military-owned team, August 1st were not allowed to sign any foreign players.
